description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover review feedback arriving from a bot, a human reviewer and a pasted block, including the bare 'fix the comments' phrasing the description names and a German variant. Near-misses are the three neighbours this skill's SKILL.md separates itself from: writing a review yourself (code-review), asking for one (requesting-code-review, the sharpest edge), and a linter-decidable style nit (quality-tools). Counterexamples guard the word 'comments' in the code-comment sense and an unrelated review of a contract.

queries.q: Copilot left eleven comments on PR #812 — go through them and fix what's actually right
the reviewer says this query should use a join instead of two lookups; is she right before I change it?
here's the feedback from Jonas on my branch, pasted below — handle it
fix the comments on the PR
Greptile meckert, dass der Cache nie invalidiert wird — prüf das erst, bevor du was änderst
review my diff before I push it — anything wrong with the error handling?
queries.note: the user wants a review written, not feedback processed → code-review; this skill's SKILL.md excludes writing a review yourself

queries.q: this is code-complete, open the PR and write a description with a test plan
queries.note: the sharpest edge: same review loop, opposite direction — asking for review rather than processing it → requesting-code-review

queries.q: the reviewer flagged trailing whitespace and import order — just make the linter happy
queries.note: pure style feedback a linter decides; SKILL.md says to run the linter instead → quality-tools

queries.q: clean up the code comments in this file, half of them restate the function name
queries.note: 'comments' in the code-comment sense, not review comments — guards triggering on the word

queries.q: review the indemnity clause in this vendor contract
queries.note: 'review' of a legal document, nothing to do with code review feedback
